newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Echo Bay Mines raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Echo Bay Mines raised.

text.p: --EVEREN Securities Inc said Thursday it raised its intermediate- and long-term ratings on Echo Bay Mines Ltd shares to outperform from market performer based on an improving production outlook.
--"Our rating of the stock represents a fundamental shift of our opinion from negative/neutral to positive," EVEREN analyst Todd Hinrichs noted in a report.
--Hinrichs said he expects Echo Bay to increase production and proven and probable reserves by at least a factor of two by the year 2000.
